relationships.subject: AngaD7L3
relationships.evidence_quote: AngaD7L3 binds serotonin (KD = 2 × 101 ± 4 × 100 nM), a novel activity for a member of the anopheline D7 long-form family.

relationships.subject: AngaD7L1
relationships.evidence_quote: AngaD7L1 was observed to bind U-46619 (KD = 4 × 102 ± 2 × 102 nM) and LTC4 (KD = 2 × 103 ± 2 × 103 nM).

relationships.subject: AngaD7L2
relationships.evidence_quote: The surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments show that AngaD7L2 binds to human coagulation factors XII (FXII), XIIa (FXIIa), and XI (FXI)

relationships.subject: AngaD7L1
relationships.evidence_quote: Following incubation with AngaD7L1 (10 μM), the vasoconstrictive response to U-46619 was significantly inhibited

relationships.subject: AngaD7L3
relationships.evidence_quote: AngaD7L3 had a dose-dependent inhibitory effect on platelet aggregation when incubated with serotonin + collagen

key_findings: A. gambiae D7 long-forms scavenge hemostatic mediators: D7L1 binds LTC4/U-46619, D7L3 binds serotonin, and each blocks platelet aggregation and vasoconstriction to its ligand.
AngaD7L2 is an anticoagulant that binds FXII, FXIIa and FXI and inhibits contact-pathway activation.
